# Security Policy

Ouro tracks pinned official Luau releases (`0.748` for `v0.1.x`). Security fixes apply to the latest `0.1.x` release on `main` and the `dist` runtime branch.

See [Security & Sandbox](https://ouro.kohl.gg/guide/pipeline/security) for VM isolation boundaries, resource caps, and bytecode verification details.

Please report vulnerabilities privately through a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/kohltastrophe/ouro/security/advisories/new) with a minimal reproducer, expected behavior, and observed impact instead of filing a public issue.
